decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.55pt;">Assessment
Against Policy DM 47, PP2335/HRH/DL/202403-AV, Design and Access Statement, Heritage
Statement, Letter of Support dated 23 May 2024, </span><span style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.55pt;">&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.55pt;">Planning Statement, Reasonable Exception
Statement, SBA-24-150 Issue 1, Transport Statement, Technical Note:
Biodiversity Net Gain, Location Plan, 1053-098, 1053-099, 1053-100 Rev P1, 1053-101
Rev P1, 1053-200 Rev P1, 1053-200 Rev P2, 1053-201 Rev P2, 1053-300 Rev P1,
191-193 High Road Small Sites Metric, Existing/Proposed Street Views.</span><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:32.6pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:
-.55pt;tab-stops:37.1pt"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="text-align: justify;">No development shall take place, including any works
of demolition, until a Detailed Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted
to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority in accordance with
the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – <a href="https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.tfl.gov.uk%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CJonathan.Kwok%40harrow.gov.uk%7C8562a9895db84a5fc15508dd3bcb1ec4%7Cd2c39953a8db4c3c97f2d2dc76fb3e2c%7C1%7C0%7C638732465802447233%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=wZJ6UfltJBhQDc3xSnHYeeJRz7Vl%2BlHbyeAlqadkyrA%3D&amp;reserved=0">www.tfl.gov.uk</a>.
The Detailed Construction Logistics Plan shall provide for:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">a) Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">b) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant
and materials;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">c) Number of HGV’s anticipated;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">d) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing
the development;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">e) Programme of work and phasing;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">f) Site layout plan;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">g) Highway condition (before, during, after);<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">h) Measures to control dust and dirt during
construction;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">i) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting
from demolition and construction works; and<o:p></o:p></p><p>





















</p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align: justify;">j) details showing the frontage/ the boundary of the site
enclosed by site hording to a minimum height of 2 metres.</p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p><br></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved Detailed Construction Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to
it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="text-align: justify; ">No development shall take place, including any works
of demolition, until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and
approved in writing by, the local planning authority in accordance with the
format and guidance provided by Transport for London – <a href="https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.tfl.gov.uk%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CJonathan.Kwok%40harrow.gov.uk%7C8562a9895db84a5fc15508dd3bcb1ec4%7Cd2c39953a8db4c3c97f2d2dc76fb3e2c%7C1%7C0%7C638732465802464429%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=yqR1iqnK9lMikF7e96MJQD98dAPcfX0Mhkfv4zPsuOA%3D&amp;reserved=0">www.tfl.gov.uk</a>
and the CLOCS standard. The Construction Method Statement shall provide for: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">a) Construction vehicles numbers, type, routing <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">b) Access arrangements to the site <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">c) Demolition method statement<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">d) Construction &amp; Storage compounds (including
areas designated for car parking, loading/unloading and turning areas <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">e) Sitting and details of wheel washing facilities <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">f) Cleaning of site entrances, site tracks and the
adjacent public highway <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">g) Timing of construction activities (including
delivery times and removal of waste) and to avoid school pick up/drop off times
<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">h) Post construction restoration/reinstatement of the
working areas and temporary access to the public highway. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">i) Where works cannot be contained wholly within the
site a plan should be submitted showing the site layout on the highway
including extent of hoarding, pedestrian routes and remaining road width for
vehicle movements <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">j) detailed timeline for the phases and implementation
of the development <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">k) measures to control the emission of dust and dirt
during<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">l) scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting
from demolition and construction works. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>





























</p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align: justify;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation
to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout
the construction period.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="text-align: justify;">Prior to the commencement of the development, except
for demolition works, hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this
statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms
of the following:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside
space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an
evacuation assembly point<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features
which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a
fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire
safety measures<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise
the risk of fire spread<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape,
and associated evacuation strategy for all building users<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation
which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this
management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which
all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;">6) provide suitable access and equipment for
firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>

















</p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align: justify;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the
approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></p>

The development hereby permitted shall not commence (except demolition works) until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:

(a)  the extension/building(s)

(b)  the ground surfacing

(c)  boundary treatment, including side access gates 

The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="text-align: justify;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to the first
occupation of the of the development hereby permitted, details of the
landscaping noted below shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
local planning authority:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left: 17px; text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Landscaping
to be Approved – conversion - including landscape masterplan, hard and soft
landscape details.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left: 17px; text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Soft
landscape works to include: Schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes,
plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers /
densities <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left: 17px; text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(c)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Written
specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left: 17px; text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(d)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->A
landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works, including
a period of 5 year period for replacements of soft landscape#<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left: 17px; text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(e)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Full
details and a maintenance scheme to show how landscaping and biodiverse green
roof will be regularly maintained<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left: 17px; text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(f)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->Scheme of hardstanding<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align: justify;"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>

















</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -35.45pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;The development shall be completed in
accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby
permitted details of bin stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing
by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available
prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.55pt;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a
Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority. The delivery and service plan shall be carried out in
accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;">The development hereby approved shall not be first occupied
until a detailed parking design and management plan is submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to set out how parking will
be allocated / controlled. The parking management plan shall set out details of
disabled parking provision; active and passive electric vehicle charging points
in accordance with London Plan standards. The arrangements so agreed shall be
put in place prior to the first occupation of the units hereby approved and
shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">Evidence of certification of
Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the
Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any part of the
development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and
operated in accordance with any approval.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; ">Prior
to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, a strategy for
provision of communal facilities for television reception (including antennae,
aerials, satellite dishes and other such equipment) has been submitted to and
approved in writing by the local planning authority. The strategy shall include
details of the size and location of equipment to be installed. The strategy and
approved details shall be implemented prior to first occupation of the
development and shall be complied with thereafter. Notwithstanding the
provisions of Schedule 2, Part 16, Class C of the Town and Country Planning
(General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), no other
microwave antenna shall be installed on or within the curtilage of the building
hereby permitted without the prior written permission of the local planning
authority.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">Notwithstanding
condition 2, the development hereby permitted shall not progress above ground
level until details of all external lighting to be provided within the site
have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
The details shall include lighting specifications, manufacturer information,
elevations, light spillage and lighting levels. The external lighting shall be
implemented in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation
of the development and shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;">The details of the Sustainable Drainage Systems Strategy
(SuDS) hereby permitted shall be implemented in full out in accordance with the
Stormwater Drainage Strategy (ref. BA-24-150 Issue 1 dated 13/06/2024) and
maintained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;">The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to
the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and
Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter
retained in that form.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify; ">All planting, seeding or turfing included in the approved
details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting season and
first seeding season following the occupation of the building. Any trees or
plants which within a period of 5 years from the occupation of the building
die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in
the next planting season with others of similar size and species.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">The refuse and
waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within
the designated refuse storage areas as shown on the approved details set out in
Condition 11 of this permission.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify; ">Notwithstanding
the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or
without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Class L
in Part 3 and Class ZA and A in Part 20 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be
carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning
authority.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Demolition of existing buildings; construction of a three storey building to provide 9 flats (7 x 2 beds and 2 x 3 beds); parking,  bin / cycle storage; shared amenity space; green roof, hard and soft landscaping
